elements.element: If renewal is not automatic, renewal occurs only by mutual written agreement.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides for automatic renewal, so the condition for this alternative is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, each renewal term is twelve (12) months.
elements.evidence: The clause provides for twelve months or the previous term if shorter, so it does not consistently require a 12-month renewal term.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer may opt out by giving thirty (30) days' written notice before renewal.
elements.evidence: Either party, including Customer, may prevent renewal by written notice at least 30 days before the current term ends.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must remind Customer of the upcoming renewal sixty (60) days before renewal.
elements.evidence: No Vendor renewal-reminder obligation appears in the operative language.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase is capped at the lesser of CPI and three percent (3%).
elements.evidence: The clause contains no restriction on renewal price increases.
The clause expressly states that each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically.

elements.element: Customer may prevent automatic renewal with a non-renewal notice deadline no more than sixty (60) days before the end of the current term.
elements.evidence: Either party, including Customer, may prevent renewal by providing written notice at least 30 days before the current term ends, which is within the permitted maximum of 60 days.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase is capped at five percent (5%).
elements.evidence: The clause contains no cap on renewal price increases.

result.reason: The redline improves the renewal term and notice period, but it satisfies neither complete position because it omits any cap on renewal price increases. It also omits the Vendor reminder required by the preferred position and permits renewal terms shorter than the preferred fixed 12-month term. Because no complete level is reached, the redline is not minimal under the stated standard. The changes are otherwise coherent and do not introduce a contradiction or disturb unrelated commercial terms.
